detailed_description: A fast Image generation model with Fun Controlnet Union 2.1

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Positive text prompt. Cannot exceed 250 characters

parameters.name: negative_prompt
parameters.description: Negative text prompt. Cannot exceed 2500 characters

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description:
Support image URL. 
Supported image formats include.jpg / .jpeg / .png
The image file size cannot exceed 10MB, andthe width and height dimensions of the image shall not be less than 300px, and the aspect ratio of the image should be between 1:2.5 ~ 2.5:1

parameters.name: guidance_scale
parameters.description: The measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when generating the image.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the generated image

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the generated image
